http.label: HTTP
http.title: The request arrives
http.text: Only signed-in users can book. The session is an opaque cookie, checked before the handler runs.

contract.label: Contract
contract.title: One schema, both ends
contract.text: The same Zod schema validates this body on the server and types the form on the client.

idempotency.label: Idempotency
idempotency.title: Retries do not book twice
idempotency.text: A repeated request with the same key and body gets the stored response instead of running again.

repository.label: Repository
repository.title: Translate the database
repository.text: The insert either works or PostgreSQL refuses it with 23P01, which becomes a domain error: the court is taken.

postgres.label: PostgreSQL
postgres.title: The database decides
postgres.text: No two confirmed bookings for the same court may overlap in time. Whatever route inserts tomorrow, this still holds.

integration.title: Bookings in, invoices out
integration.headline: Event bookings in, invoices an accountant accepts out
integration.text: A mapping and normalisation layer between an events platform and an invoicing ERP: simplified invoices, management expenses and VAT. I learned the accounting domain from scratch to model it correctly.

standards.title: A standard the linter enforces
standards.headline: A code standard nobody has to remember
standards.text: There were no conventions. I wrote a layered architecture as lint rules, with size limits per layer, complexity limits and no any, plus the branching strategy, CI, Husky, Commitlint and pre-merge checks. Written for two developers; six work on it today.

product.title: A multi-tenant events platform
product.headline: One platform, every company its own
product.text: Role-based permissions, theming per company and department, itineraries, budgets and cost modules driven by formulas. In production and growing.

cloud.title: Travel management on Azure
cloud.headline: A travel app, modelled from zero on Azure
cloud.text: An application for an external client. I designed its NoSQL data model from scratch on Cosmos DB, with files in Azure Storage.

people.title: Two interns, now juniors
people.headline: From intern to junior developer
people.text: Onboarding, task breakdown, code reviews and incident resolution, day to day, until both could work on their own on top of the team’s standard.

race.label: Strategy

lock.label: Wait in line
lock.explain: SELECT … FOR UPDATE locks the court: the others wait their turn, then find the slot taken.

retry.label: Retry on conflict
retry.explain: Nobody waits: the losers see the version changed and try again, up to three times.

refuse.label: Let PostgreSQL refuse
refuse.explain: The EXCLUDE constraint rejects every overlapping insert with 23P01: the database decides.

principles: Short decision records: the problem, the options, why this one.
If a convention matters, a linter or a CI check holds it, not a wiki page.
Concurrency against a real database, flows in a real browser.
I design and decide; AI helps implement. Nothing merges without review and green tests.
